facts.claim: 贝儿匆匆吃完饭，为避开那张长椅改走大客厅去吉纳维芙的办公室。
facts.quote: rather than cut across the courtyard garden, I went through the Great Den

facts.claim: 她推断山缪向女儿坦白是因昨天健二之事，并认定他是更强的嫌犯。
facts.quote: Samuel Spruce had become a stronger suspect

facts.claim: 她轻声走上旋梯，吉纳维芙的阁楼近乎全黑，遮光帘全被放下。
facts.quote: I emerged from the staircase into near-total darkness.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙说得知真相后仍觉得自己破碎，自己写的一切都是谎言。
facts.quote: Everything I’ve written is a lie. Every word.

facts.claim: 贝儿讲出姐姐卡西的故事：她不停羞辱失意的姐姐，两周后卡西自杀。
facts.quote: She killed herself two weeks after she came home.

facts.claim: 贝儿承认自己因愧疚改名，“Belle Currer”也是假名，父母同样怪她。
facts.quote: I was the coward who had changed my name after what I’d done.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙坦白昨日对贝儿和亚当斯探长撒谎，她回家时看见了迪尔德丽的尸体。
facts.quote: I lied to you and Detective Adams yesterday.

facts.claim: 吉纳维芙决心不再假装平静，放塞思去研究所，并说自己准备变“咸”。
facts.quote: I think I’m ready to be salty.

relations.rel: 知己；互相坦白各自的秘密与愧疚
relations.quote: Can I confess something to you?

relations.rel: 姐妹；贝儿曾持续羞辱姐姐，姐姐两周后自杀
relations.quote: I had an older sister. Her name was Cassie

relations.rel: 夫妻；丹想坦白，吉纳维芙决定隐瞒
relations.quote: He wanted to come clean when the detective came yesterday.

relations.rel: 吉纳维芙回家时看见其尸体，却谎称没看见
relations.quote: when I was coming back in, I did see her

relations.rel: 母子；吉纳维芙一直拦着儿子不让去研究所
relations.quote: no reason Seth shouldn’t go to the Institute this summer

relations.rel: 贝儿将其列为更强的谋杀嫌疑人
relations.quote: a stronger suspect than I had previously considered him to be

numbers.claim: 迪尔德丽两天前不请自来
numbers.quote: two days earlier, when Deirdre Gregory had arrived unannounced

numbers.claim: 不到四十八小时后就吐露了那个秘密
numbers.quote: divulge that secret less than forty-eight hours later
She killed herself two weeks after she came home.

numbers.claim: 这一切发生在二十年前
numbers.quote: This all went down twenty years ago, by the way.
I was two years younger and always in her shadow

numbers.claim: 迪尔德丽是在凌晨两点到四点之间来的
numbers.quote: between two and four in the morning

numbers.claim: 吉纳维芙凌晨四点回到屋里
numbers.quote: When I came back in at four, it was still dark.
It’s why I haven’t slept in two days.

numbers.claim: 成长过程中只有姐妹两人
numbers.quote: It was just the two of us growing up.

numbers.claim: 父母等于失去了两个孩子，但其中一个可挽回
numbers.quote: rather than losing one child, they lost two

numbers.claim: 两个哭成泪人的人平静下来
numbers.quote: once we two blubberers had calmed down

turning_point: 吉纳维芙坦白她回家时其实已看见迪尔德丽的尸体（此前谎称没看见），并决意不再假装平静、准备“变咸”；同时贝儿首次说出姐姐卡西因她羞辱而自杀的秘密——两人的互相坦白同时改写了案件时间线与人物关系。
notes: 不确定处：“Belle Currer”是否为其真名，文本仅暗示是假名，真名未给出；丹是否参与隐瞒由吉纳维芙一人决定，文本未判定其是否有罪；山缪是否真为凶手本章仅推断，未证实。
